'''2010 Worlds Day 2 PMJ DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[PMJ]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Ras Jude Coda. Transcription note: sheet Name "PMJ" (initials only)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
